description.en: Tasks from the auditory exercises: draw the implementation diagram, then check it against the model solution.

question.en: Draw an implementation diagram for a library. The library is located in Skopje, and has local branches in three cities in Macedonia (Ohrid, Bitola and Stip). The library system should be web-based, except the book rental module. The library in Skopje has 5 points for renting books, while in other cities there is one point. The library system should be installed on a separate server in Skopje (the database should be installed on a separate server). The users can search books online and also on the terminals placed in the halls of the libraries (Skopje - 15, Ohrid and Stip - 10, Bitola - 12). The library in Skopje has a special computer equipped with a scanner, a printer and a bar code reader which is used for inserting new books in the library system.

question.en: Draw an implementation diagram for an airline. The airline has one central server where all data is stored. The ticket sales from the sales points are made by accessing the central server through an appropriate connection. At each point there can be multiple computers that use the data from the server, and all share the same printer. On the central server, apart from the database, the appropriate software application should be stored. This app will be used by the sales points employees and passengers who will make ticket reservations online.
